setup_guide_subtitle: Required to receive orders when app is in background
setup_guide_warning: Without these settings, your phone will block order notifications and you will MISS orders!
setup_guide_step1_subtitle: Tap the button below — Android will ask you to confirm
setup_guide_step3_subtitle: Make sure My Shop notifications are turned ON
setup_guide_xiaomi_steps:
1. Settings → Apps → Manage Apps
2. Find "My Shop"
3. Tap "Autostart" → Turn ON
4. Tap "Battery Saver" → No Restrictions
setup_guide_oppo_steps:
1. Phone Manager → Privacy Permissions
2. Find "My Shop" → Auto Launch → ON
3. Settings → Battery → App Battery Management
4. My Shop → Allow background activity
setup_guide_vivo_steps:
1. Settings → Battery
2. Background Power Management
3. Find "My Shop" → Do Not Restrict
4. Settings → Apps → My Shop → Background popup → Allow
setup_guide_huawei_steps:
1. Phone Manager → App Launch
2. Find "My Shop" → Turn OFF Auto-manage
3. Enable: Auto-launch + Secondary launch + Run in background
setup_guide_samsung_steps:
1. Settings → Apps → My Shop → Battery
2. Select "Unrestricted"
3. Turn OFF "Put unused apps to sleep"
setup_guide_generic_steps:
1. Settings → Apps → My Shop
2. Battery / Power settings
3. Select "Unrestricted" or "No restriction"
4. Enable "AutoStart" or "Auto Launch" if available
